cards.card_text: After the elders of the nearest city say, "Accept this atonement, O LORD…" Moses says the bloodshed will be atoned for.
cards.verse_text: Accept this atonement, O LORD, for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed, and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them.” And the bloodshed will be atoned for.
cards.snippet: …the shedding of innocent blood against them.” And the bloodshed will be atoned for.

cards.card_text: True or false: The LORD says enough sacrifices and offerings can still atone for the iniquity of Eli's house.
cards.verse_text: Therefore I have sworn to the house of Eli, ‘The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’”
cards.snippet: …the house of Eli, ‘The iniquity of Eli’s house shall never be atoned for by sacrifice or offering.’”

cards.card_text: Then Asaph asks the God of their salvation to help them, deliver them and atone for their sins.
cards.verse_text: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
cards.snippet: …of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.

cards.card_text: Iniquity is atoned for by loving devotion and faithfulness.
cards.verse_text: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from evil.
cards.snippet: By loving devotion and faithfulness iniquity is atoned for, and by the fear of the LORD one turns aside from…

cards.card_text: The seraph says, "Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for." One touch, and the man who just said "I am ruined" hears that his sin is atoned for.
cards.verse_text: And with it he touched my mouth and said: “Now that this has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”
cards.snippet: …has touched your lips, your iniquity is removed and your sin is atoned for.”

cards.card_text: Then the LORD of Hosts speaks in the prophet's hearing: until your dying day, this sin of yours will ___ be atoned for.
cards.verse_text: The LORD of Hosts has revealed in my hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.
cards.snippet: …hearing: “Until your dying day, this sin of yours will never be atoned for,” says the Lord GOD of Hosts.

cards.card_text: After the warfare and exile, the text says Jacob's ___ will be atoned for.
cards.verse_text: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this: When he makes all the altar stones like crushed bits of chalk, no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing.
cards.snippet: Therefore Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for, and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will…
